color.note: Six groups: primary, secondary, accent, status, content and surface. One light theme, matching the clinic website.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Charcoal. The one main action on a screen: primary button fill and border, selected chip, count badges.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-content
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and secondary fills (17:1 on primary, 6.5:1 on secondary).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Deep bronze. Accent button fill, bronze text, the italic accent word in titles, the main line in charts (6.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: secondary-border
tokens.usage: Bronze. Focus ring, hover border on clickable cards, active nav bar and tab underline, outline-bronze buttons, dashed drop zone (4.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: secondary-content
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Champagne. Decoration only: the accent word on dark imagery, highlights. Never text on a light surface (1.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Reference-range band behind result charts, soft highlights.

tokens.name: accent-content
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (9:1).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: IN RANGE, PAID, CONFIRMED text and icon, on status-success-bg (4.9:1) or surface (5.4:1).

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of success pills.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: BORDERLINE, AWAITING, days-left warnings, on status-warning-bg (4.7:1) or surface (5.3:1).

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of warning pills and alert bars.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: OUT OF RANGE values, allergies, overdue, errors, cancel and reject buttons, on status-danger-bg (5.5:1) or surface (6:1).

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of danger pills and alert bars.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: matched, in progress, results pending, on status-info-bg (5.5:1).

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of info pills and alert bars.

tokens.name: content
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and values on every surface (17:1 on surface).

tokens.name: content-muted
tokens.usage: Meta, eyebrows, labels, table headers and icons on every surface (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: content-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse, dark imagery and danger fills.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Warm stone page ground for both portals.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets and dialogs, with a surface-border hairline.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table row hover, preparation notes, neutral pills.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Active navigation row, progress tracks, toggle track.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Demo banner, toasts, image overlays, barcode bars.

tokens.name: surface-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines on cards, tables, inputs and dividers. Decorative (1.3:1): never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind side sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Sign-in and other full-bleed image panels only, in on-dark.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top left, under an eyebrow. 32px / 36px below 560px wide.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen and sheet titles.

styles.name: card-display
styles.usage: The name of the thing a card is about: an order, a medication, an appointment.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Results need to reach us two weeks before your appointment.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta, helper text, table secondary lines, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Result values in tables. Tabular figures, right aligned.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: Stat cards, latest value in a marker card, totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above titles, form labels, table headers, card kickers, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Every button and tab label, uppercase.

styles.name: pill-label
styles.usage: Status pills, uppercase, always beside an icon.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside pills, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards between lines and groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap on dense screens, mobile gutter minimum, sheet field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, mobile page padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page header to content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

radius.note: Square by default. The brand reads crisp, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, tabs, drop zones, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and count badges.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and table containers (the site's .25rem).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars only.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and the app shell.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards and table rows.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Status pills.

tokens.name: nav-row
tokens.usage: Sidebar navigation rows.

tokens.name: table-row
tokens.usage: Minimum table row height.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar of both portals.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

stroke.note: Borders do the work shadows do elsewhere.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Every button border, the focus ring, active tab underline, active nav bar.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: Left edge of alert bars and at-risk order cards only.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke width (lucide).
